Vessel struck by suspected projectile in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says

A vessel was struck by a suspected unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Monday evening, causing a fire that has since been extinguished, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said.

The vessel is underway and its crew are safe. No environmental impact has been reported, and damage has not been assessed, UKMTO said, citing a third-party report.

UKMTO advised vessels to transit with caution as authorities investigate.

[UKMTO product reference: WARNING 143-26 — supersedes 142-26 of 23 September as the most recent UKMTO warning. Verbatim UKMTO wording as quoted by multiple carriers: "UKMTO has received a third-party report of a vessel struck by a suspected unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in a fire. The fire has since been extinguished and the vessel is underway. Crew are safe, there has been no reported environmental impact or damage assessment."]
